|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Ket Maliss (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may ▲ Greedo, Hem Dazon, Dannik Jerriko, Beedo, or Reegesk. During your deploy phase you may ▼ one docking bay. While Emperor of destiny > 5 not on table, Black Sun agents are forfeit +2 and defense value +1. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Unless Emperor Palpatine on table, Black Sun agents are defense value +1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, may take Beedo, Dannik Jerriko, Greedo, Hem Dazon, or Reegesk into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your deploy phase, may deploy a docking bay from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Once per turn, may ▲ Greedo, Hem Dazon, Dannik Jerriko, Beedo, or Reegesk. During your deploy phase you may ▼ one docking bay. While” → “Unless”; “of destiny > 5 not” → “Palpatine”; removed “forfeit +2 and”; “+1. [Immune” → “+1 and forfeit +2. Once per turn, may take Beedo, Dannik Jerriko, Greedo, Hem Dazon, or Reegesk into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your deploy phase, may deploy a docking bay from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 38. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
